tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: The brand colour. The highlight stroke behind the wordmark, the app-icon ground, and big brand blocks. Only ever sits BEHIND ink text — never use lime for text or thin lines on white (it fails contrast).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Wordmark, headlines and body text on paper, mist and lime.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Default ground. The logo lives on white first.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Quiet surfaces: cards, icon trays, section bands.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and outlines of white tiles (e.g. the white app icon on white).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and labels on paper or mist (5.3:1 on paper).

tokens.name: lime-ink
tokens.usage: When green must be text on white (a link, a small label). Never used in the logo.

families.body: "IBM Plex Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The logo only. Always with the lime highlight behind "fannan".

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: Your next job is looking for you.

styles.name: arabic-wordmark
styles.usage: The Arabic logo only, with the lime highlight.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Put your best work on one link, made for the studios and clients who hire.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small caps labels, tags, captions; letter-spacing 0.08em.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside labels.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding on small items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, page gutters on mobile.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Space between blocks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags and small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: App icon at 84–92px (scale ~24% of its size).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills and toggles.

highlight.note: The geometry of the chisel stroke behind the wordmark. Keep it identical everywhere.

tokens.name: hl-skew
tokens.usage: skewX of the stroke (mirror to +14deg for Arabic).

tokens.name: hl-rotate
tokens.usage: Slight tilt of the stroke (+1.5deg for Arabic).

tokens.name: hl-top
tokens.usage: Stroke starts at this height of the word box (the lower half of the letters).

tokens.name: hl-bottom
tokens.usage: Stroke ends this far above the bottom of the word box.

tokens.name: hl-overhang
tokens.usage: How far the stroke runs past the first letter; ~0.09em past the last.
